response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), o AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS v FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.a FROM t, o WHERE t.a > o.v), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a FROM k1, m WHERE k1.a > m.v2) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k2.a - o.v) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(k2.a - m.v2) AS mean_above_second_avg FROM k2, o, m

assumptions.assumption: The 'overall average pulse rate' is the pooled average of pulsepersec over all signal rows with non-null values (not the mean of the per-telescope averages).
The 'second average' is the mean of the per-telescope averages of the telescopes that passed the first filter, with the comparison strict (>).
Telescopes whose pulsepersec values are all NULL have a NULL average and drop out at the first comparison.

alternatives.interpretation: The 'overall average' is the mean of the per-telescope averages, so each telescope counts equally regardless of how many signals it has.
